hero.title2: AI call centers and PDPL readiness.
hero.subtitle: Voice and chat agents in Arabic and English, 24x7, and a security program that keeps personal data protected and traceable.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: In healthcare, Cybersecurity and Intelligent Operations are primary fits; Sovereign AI and Blockchain are relevant; IoT & Edge is a limited fit. The typical first engagement is the AI Call Center or a PDPL readiness assessment.

challenges.title: Personal data under PDPL
challenges.body: PDPL applies to all entities processing personal data in the Kingdom.

challenges.title: Contact volume, in two languages
challenges.body: Voice and chat agents resolve queries 24x7, in Arabic and English, and hand over to a human when sentiment turns.

challenges.title: Data on screens, files and prints
challenges.body: Legacy DLP leaves the screen, print and file gap open.

useCases.title: AI Call Center
useCases.body: An autonomous agent for bookings and FAQs, a co-pilot for the live agent, and a call-out agent that confirms every resolved ticket.

useCases.title: PDPL readiness
useCases.body: Data mapping, privacy impact assessments and records of processing.

useCases.title: Data watermarking
useCases.body: Screen, file and print watermarking, so every copy is traceable to user and device.

useCases.title: Healthcare agents
useCases.body: A healthcare vertical is in build on the agentic AI platform, on the same data and guardrails.

vision2030.body: Data and AI stay in-Kingdom, aligned with NCA, SDAIA and PDPL. Health is also a destination for the dedicated Sovereign AI Factory.
